summary.text: Christy Zito represents Idaho Senate District 8 and lives in Mountain Home; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a first term, with earlier service of two House terms (2016-2020) and one Senate term (2020-2022).

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Zito was born in Utah and grew up ranching in Stone, Idaho.
The biography lists work as a small business owner and farm owner-operator, and service as a PTA president and school board member.
